title: SUMX evaluates a column expression once per row of the iterated table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", SUMX ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] * Sales[Quantity] ) )

source.quote: You have a row context whenever you iterate a table, either explicitly (using an iterator) or implicitly (in a calculated column)
source.supports: an iterator creates a row context, in which a column reference gives the value in the current row

source.quote: The operator determines the type of conversion DAX performs by casting the values it requires before doing the requested operation.
source.supports: the multiplication table gives INTEGER * INTEGER as INTEGER

derivation: Sales[Quantity] over the 7 rows is 1, 2, 1, 5, 2, 3, 1. Squared per row: 1 + 4 + 1 + 25 + 4 + 9 + 1 = 45. A sum of squares (45) differs from the square of the sum (15 * 15 = 225), so the expression must be evaluated row by row.
notes: Type: learn.microsoft.com gives 'A decimal number' as the return value of both SUM and SUMX; the result is taken to have the type of the summed expression, an integer.
